coverageFindings.region: Printed1 game rules and IID paragraph

coverageFindings.finding: Cross-page rewrite is preserved. Minimum is outside expectation; the scalar comparator is fixed across rounds and outcomes. Attainment and feasible population mean remain a source gap. No E[min] interchange is licensed.

Arbitrary data, explicit deterministic qualifier for dropping expectation, best single hindsight comparator, pathwise minimum and its attainment gap are retained. The contextual transition is not a probability-preserving equality of the two benchmark notions.

topologyFindings: The 17 author-source routes are conjunctions annotated as definitions, interpretations or assertions with open gaps. No invented OR proof replaces a required premise. There are no competing printed sufficient routes on these pages.

R-DETERMINISTIC is contextual: its conclusion itself retains the if-deterministic qualifier. It does not infer learner determinism from arbitrary data. General no-regret has no gap-reachability entries because it is a literal definition, not an established convergence theorem.

The five source-gap nodes remain open. In particular R-PATHWISE-DEFINITION includes G-PATHWISE-MINIMUM, and R-NONNEGATIVE retains the causal and normalization gaps recursively. No graph closure is obtained from an asserted source sentence.

Private tape, joint process independence, generated sigma fields and subordinate measurable predictions are a separate proposed extension. No seed or sigma-field construction is printed on these pages; the printed expectation subscript lists the targets. Extension expectations must include the joint tape/target law.

Whole-process independence of the tape plus joint target independence is essential to produce joint tape-and-past/current independence. Coordinatewise seed independence or pairwise target statements cannot substitute silently. The packet keeps this as E-JOINT-REGROUPING.

The generated G_t is increasing, while the subordinate family F_t need not be increasing. One-round prediction independence uses containment and measurability, not monotonicity of F. The monotonicity conclusion is separate.

Joint policy measurability, finite-history composition, actual almost-sure legal histories and moment/integrability production remain explicit derived obligations. Feasibility on legal cubes for every seed is not a bound on arbitrary off-cube histories.

Abstract predictable and concrete policy cumulative endpoints are distinct conclusions, not alternative OR proofs of one already-complete printed theorem. Reuse of the expected-fixed source node retains its probability and attained-minimum gaps until later independent proof review.

specificGaps.dischargeStatus: None discharged by this topology review. Later implementation may discharge a declared derived subset, but must not claim it supplies a printed author proof.

semanticStageRequirements: Compare all seven semantic slots against the sealed exact declarations and fresh blind reconstruction after this verdict is saved.

Check literal generated-information definition, recursive binders, whole-process seed independence, probability-space hypotheses, measurable target/history/policy maps, a.s. versus pointwise feasibility, and actual producer versus assumed independence.
Verify derived cumulative square identity and finite nonnegativity without importing a proof conclusion as a premise. Distinguish type and value dependencies from historical guessed reuse edges.

Retain T=0 as an empty-prefix extension only. Source average needs positive horizon. Finite lower bound or natural normalization gives neither the asymptotic equivalence proof nor successful learner convergence.

Keep no universal kernel representation, no sigma-field completion/AE factorization, no arbitrary side information, no conditional-per-seed/pathwise/high-probability claim and no whole-chapter/book completion.
